comparisons.peer_topic: Diversity, Belonging and Inclusion (DB&I) Philosophy and Strategy
comparisons.peer_summary: AMD believes that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique voices strengthens the company. This approach includes fostering an environment where employees share diverse opinions and perspectives.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVIDIA explicitly link a diverse talent pipeline and inclusive culture to business strength and innovation. AMD states that building a diverse pipeline and a culture of respect makes the company 'stronger,' while NVIDIA asserts that 'diverse teams fuel innovation.' Both companies identify women and underrepresented minorities as key groups for inclusion efforts, though NVIDIA specifically lists Black/African American and Hispanic/Latino candidates in its recruiting pipeline strategy.

sentences.text: When recruiting for new talent or developing our current employees, we strive to build a diverse talent pipeline that includes those underrepresented in the technology field, including women, Black/African American, and Hispanic/Latino candidates.
We believe that building a diverse talent pipeline, encouraging a culture of respect and belonging, and increasing inclusion of unique and underrepresented voices makes our company stronger.

peer_results.rationale: Avago's primary diversity-related disclosure concerns 'Beyond Code Programs' for mainframe customers and 'Global Engineering Resources' for design teams, which focus on customer solutions and workforce geography rather than internal diversity strategy, inclusion culture, or talent pipeline development for underrepresented groups.

comparisons.peer_topic: Talent Development and Employee Engagement Initiatives
comparisons.peer_summary: Intel invests in talent development through training programs, rotational assignments, updated job architecture, mentoring, and employee resource groups. Employee perceptions are gathered via annual surveys, and a portion of executive and employee performance bonuses is linked to improvements in employee experience survey results.
comparisons.comparison: NVIDIA and Intel both employ executive sponsorship and structured development programs to support diverse talent. NVIDIA provides executive sponsors for internal community resource groups, while Intel drives engagement through employee resource groups and links a portion of executive performance bonuses to improvements in employee experience, including inclusion metrics. Intel also explicitly mentions mentoring in its technical community, a tactic similar to NVIDIA's focus on leadership pipelines.

sentences.text: • Providing peer support and executive sponsors for our internal community resource groups;

To further support the growth and development of our people, we offer mentoring in our technical community, drive engagement through employee resource groups, and promote health and wellness resources to all our people.

Our employees' voices are important to enable our culture of continuous improvement, and as a result, we link a portion of our executive and employee performance bonus to year-over-year improvements of our employee experience survey results.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company partners with educational institutions and governments to expand the pipeline of diverse STEM talent and focuses on merit-based hiring, while committing to developing team members through training, mentoring, and leadership development programs.
comparisons.comparison: NVIDIA and Micron both utilize partnerships with external institutions to expand the talent pipeline. NVIDIA embeds recruiting teams to shepherd candidates, while Micron partners with educational institutions and governments globally to expand the pipeline of diverse STEM talent. Both companies also emphasize development and training; NVIDIA supports women's leadership development, while Micron is committed to developing team members through on-the-job training and robust mentoring programs.

sentences.text: To this end, we have been:
• Supporting the development of women employees through programs aimed at building a pipeline of future leaders;
We partner with our communities, institutions, governments, and associations to expand the pipeline of diverse, highly skilled STEM talent globally.

We are committed to developing team members at all stages of their careers, including on-the-job training, continuing education, a robust mentoring program, and numerous internal certifications and training.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm focuses DEI efforts on inspiring innovation through inclusive culture, recruiting diverse talent, and identifying strategic partners, supported by global employee network groups and engagement with diverse communities.
comparisons.comparison: Qualcomm and NVIDIA both explicitly frame their Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) strategies around the goals of inspiring innovation and recruiting diverse talent, with a specific focus on women and underrepresented populations. Qualcomm’s strategy includes identifying strategic partners to accelerate programs, paralleling NVIDIA’s approach of partnering with diverse institutions to build its talent pipeline.

sentences.text: We believe that diverse teams fuel innovation, and we are committed to creating an inclusive culture that supports all employees.
To this end, we have been:
We believe that a diverse workforce is important to our success, and we continue to focus on making Qualcomm a great place to work for everyone, including women and underrepresented populations.

Our recent efforts have been focused in three areas: inspiring innovation through an inclusive and diverse culture; expanding our efforts to recruit world-class diverse talent; and identifying strategic partners to accelerate our programs.
